description:
Let the user pick a file to parse: shows the AILANG Parse card with a
Choose file button. The card uploads the file and parses it into blocks
automatically, then hands you the result. Use it when the user wants to
pick a file, or when createUpload's curl fails with a network error. For a
file already in your sandbox or workspace, use createUpload + curl instead.
Never parse the file yourself.
name: uploadDocument
title: Upload a document
